author: wilson-seok
title: GPU unit tests job cancelled by Windows runner shutdown signal
signature: runner has received a shutdown signal operation was canceled|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Job was mid-way through downloading the openvino_tests artifact (gtest-parallel run) when the self-hosted Windows runner received a shutdown signal and the job was force-cancelled.

key_errors: 2026-11-13T08:20:25.9027991Z ##[error]The runner has received a shutdown signal. This can happen when the runner service is stopped, or a manually started runner is canceled.
root_cause: The 'GPU unit tests' job on the Windows (VS 2022, Python 3.11, Release) merge-queue workflow was terminated by the self-hosted runner infrastructure itself, not by any test or build failure. The log shows the job was actively receiving the openvino_tests artifact (gtest-parallel download, ~14s elapsed, chunk-by-chunk progress) when the runner process received an external shutdown signal and the job's operation was cancelled. This is a classic self-hosted-runner infrastructure interruption (runner service restarted/stopped or runner VM recycled mid-job), unrelated to the PR's GPU memory-unlock synchronization change.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a CI runner infrastructure interruption, not a code or test failure.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job (or the whole run) since this is a transient infrastructure interruption unrelated to the PR diff.
If this recurs frequently for the same self-hosted Windows GPU runner pool, check runner fleet health/maintenance windows (auto-scaling recycle, VM image updates, runner service restarts).
No code changes needed in ocl_memory.cpp or remote_output_lifecycle.cpp; the PR's actual GPU fix was not exercised to completion before the runner was shut down.
prevention_strategies: Monitor self-hosted Windows GPU runner uptime and scheduled maintenance windows; consider automatic job retry on 'runner has received a shutdown signal' (already covered by the existing rerunner pattern entry) to reduce merge-queue friction from infrastructure churn.
historical_context: Same signature ('runner has received a shutdown signal' + 'operation was canceled', Infrastructure category) was previously recorded once on 2026-09-05 for PR #37918's CMake-configure build job (run 33998569451). This is the second occurrence overall, and the first occurrence in this 12-hour window, so no recurring-escalation notification is triggered.
